description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice/Dark Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice/Dark, Unlimited Ice/Dark Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice/Dark Abilities, Ice/Dark Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Ice/Dark Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice/Dark abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE or Dark/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Ice or En-Dark

description.name: War-Awoken Glacial Frost (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Ice/Dark/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice/Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/2 En-Ice/Dark members
WS Blue: Dualcast Ice/Dark, Instant Ice/Dark & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: Dualcast Ice/Dark, Instant Ice/Dark & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to party
